pois.name: Ahuena Heiau
pois.description: King Kamehameha I died here on 1819-05-08.

pois.name: Kaloko-Honokōhau National Historical Park
pois.intro: Kaloko-Honokōhau National Historical Park is a United States National Historical Park located in the Kona District on Hawaiʻi Island in the U.S. state of Hawaiʻi. It includes the National Historic Landmarked archaeological site known as the Honokōhau Settlement.

pois.name: Mokuaikaua Church
pois.intro: Mokuʻaikaua Church, located on the "Big Island" of Hawaii, is the oldest Christian church in the Hawaiian Islands. The congregation dates to 1820 and the building was completed in 1837.

pois.name: Hulihe‘e Palace Museum
pois.intro: The Huliheʻe Palace is located in historic Kailua-Kona, Hawaiʻi, on Ali'i Drive. The former vacation home of Hawaiian royalty, it was converted to a museum run by the Daughters of Hawaiʻi, showcasing furniture and artifacts.

pois.name: Kamakahonu
pois.intro: Kamakahonu, the residence of Kamehameha I, was located at the north end of Kailua Bay in Kailua-Kona on Hawaiʻi Island.

pois.name: Keauhou Hōlua Slide
pois.intro: The Kāneaka Hōlua Slide, a.k.a. the Keauhou Hōlua Slide, is located in Keauhou on the island of Hawaiʻi.

pois.name: Kona Elks Hawaii Lodge #2616
pois.description: Social Club of Benevolent Protective Order of the Elks, including a restaurant, bar and theater.

pois.name: Old Kona Airport State Recreation Area
pois.intro: Old Kona Airport State Recreation Area is a park built on the site of an old landing strip just north of Kailua, Hawaii County, Hawaii.

pois.name: Sadie Seymour Botanical Gardens
pois.intro: The Sadie Seymour Botanical Gardens are nonprofit botanical gardens located on the grounds of the Kona Educational Foundation Center at 76-6280 Kuakini Highway, Kailua-Kona, Hawaiʻi island, Hawaiʻi. Coordinates are 19°36′49.5″N 155°58′6″W. They are open daily except on weekends; admission is free, but donations accepted.

pois.name: Kona Cloud Forest - Guided Walking Tours
pois.description: The Only Cloud Forest in the United States. Three Hour Guided Walking Tours weather permitting. All tours are offered through our educational non profit Painted Trees of Hawaii. All donations are 100% tax deductible. All tours are by appointment only.

pois.name: Ooma Beach
pois.intro: Keāhole Point is the westernmost point of the island of Hawaiʻi. The Kona International Airport was moved here from directly north of the town of Kailua-Kona in 1970, when the previous smaller airstrip was converted into the Old Kona Airport State Recreation Area.
